[SIMPLIFICATION] [combat damage assignment] This slice assigns combat damage automatically, in lethal-first order (5 attacker(s), 0 declared blocker(s)). That is a bounded simplification of CR 510.1c, which lets the attacking player divide a blocked creature's damage among its blockers however they choose; typed damage assignment is not modeled yet.

CR 510.1c: A blocked creature assigns its combat damage to the creatures blocking it. With one blocker it assigns all of it; with two or more it divides the damage among them as its controller chooses. There is no lethal-first requirement (the old wording was removed).
CR 510.2: All combat damage is dealt simultaneously.
